title: Employees above average salary
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on employees.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees) ORDER BY salary DESC

validation.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INT, name VARCHAR(50), salary INT); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'A', 40000), (2, 'B', 50000), (3, 'C', 60000), (4, 'D', 70000), (5, 'E', 80000);
